national_economy_bad.rule: (x-1)/3 for x=1..4; higher is worse; current national conditions

economic_priority.rule: any mentioned among economy, rising prices, unemployment; strict national priority routing

economic_priority_personal.rule: same three topics for personal priorities; strict personal routing

party_distrust.rule: 0=tend to trust (1), 1=tend not to trust (2); DK missing

government_distrust.rule: 0=tend to trust (1), 1=tend not to trust (2); not government-performance rating

age_scaled.rule: (age-50)/20, uniform adult restriction 18..98; not verified voting eligibility

female.rule: 1=female (2), 0=male (1); source has only two gender categories

left_right.rule: (x-5.5)/4.5 for 1..10; missing set to fixed midpoint 0 plus explicit missing indicator; also squared term

bill_difficulty.rule: (3-x)/2 for x=1..3; higher is greater difficulty paying bills last year

weight_country.rule: W31 demographic voting-age poststratification; normalize within analytic country before country-equal weighting

weight_population.rule: W52 additionally accounts for EU country population; sensitivity only

core_question_names: Current national economy, national priority, government trust, party trust
country_exclusions: CZ/HU caretaker status unresolved; choice-type contrasts require verified alternatives
unresolved_policy: Retain as unresolved in coverage tables; exclude from classified outcome models; no imputed party
bootstrap_weight_rule: Resample countries, retain within-country weights; standardize contrasts over resampled country distribution
limitations: No pre-election party attachment or earlier vote in selected EB data; ideology is measured post-election.
Known party participants verify availability of categories, not an exhaustive ballot census.
Complete-case selection and unresolved parties can depend on politics; country-equal weighting does not correct them.
Left-right and demographics with missing values retain explicit missing indicators/categories.
These counts and predictor distributions are not outcome associations.
